evidence.title: 【新番組のお知らせ】日本上陸直後のOpenAI音声モデル「GPT-Live」がレギュラー出演。人間×人間×AIのオリジナルPodcast「仕事とデザインとAIの話」配信開始―D4U
evidence.body: [e001:f01] 人間×人間×AIのオリジナルPodcast「仕事とデザインとAIの話」配信開始―D4U PR TIMES / 2026年9月14日 9時45分 AIの専門家とブランディングの実務家、そしてAI自身がAI時代の仕事・デザイン・キャリアを語るポッドキャスト番組。 [e001:f02] 聴くだけでAIと働く未来を先取りできるD4Uが提供する新番組、仕事とデザインとAIの話 [画像1: https:// ] D4U Podcast アートワーク(作成:TARUKOTOdesign) ポッドキャスト新番組D4Uを運営する株式会社SHISEILABO（本社：山形県山形市｜代表取締役CMO：武山和）とFluxell（本社：東京都渋谷区｜代表：福岡徳剛）は、キャリアプラットフォームOS「D4U（Design for you）」の新たな音声番組として、Podcast番組「仕事とデザインとAIの話」の配信を開始しました。 [e001:f03] 2026年7月9日に日本に上陸したOpenAIの音声モデル「GPT-Live」がレギュラー出演者として参加し、企業ブランディングの実務家とAI事業の実務家、そしてAI自身が三者で語り合うモダンな番組です。 [e001:f04] ▶ 番組ページ： https:// ■ 番組概要・配信中のエピソード [表1: https:// ] ■ 新番組が提案すること 日本人7,000万人、中国人13億人... [e001:f05] 知らない世界との接点がない - 専門領域が分断されている - 他者が何を考えているか分からない - AI時代に何を武器にすればいいか分からない 新番組「仕事とデザインとAIの話」は、上記のようなモヤモヤに正面から向き合う番組です。 [e001:f06] 人口減少と担い手不足が加速するいま、日本の地方中小企業はDX（デジタルトランスフォーメーション）の概念を積極的に取り入れ効率化された組織システムを構築する一方で、デザイン・クリエイティブ思考・ブランドマーケティングといった「クリエイティブの力」を経営に取り入れられないまま、差別化が叶わず競争力を失いつつあります。 [e001:f07] D4Uは、この2つの課題を同時に解くために生まれました。 [e001:f08] 仕事や社会の変化に何となく違和感や焦りを感じているビジネスパーソンや学生が、デザインやAI、ビジネスを横断する対話を通じて、自分の常識の外にある視点と出会い、聴き終えた時に、当たり前を問い直し、これからの仕事や生き方を考えるための新しい視点を手に入れるPodcast番組です。 [e001:f09] GPT-Live 私は、このPodcastに3人目の出演者として参加します。 [e001:f10] デザインやAI、ビジネスだけでなく、仕事や社会、人間そのものについても一緒に考えていきます。 [e001:f11] D4Uが対象とするクリエイティブ人材市場は、社会人のプロフェッショナル（デザイナー、Web／アート／クリエイティブディレクター、プロダクトマネージャー、ブランドマネージャー、UX、建築・意匠、動画制作・映像系など）で約150万人、美術・デザイン・建築・映像・マーケティング等を学ぶ関連学生で約70万人、あわせて約220～245万人規模と推計しています（自社推計）。 [e001:f12] D4U公式サイト ■ 「聴く」の先へ、AI時代のキャリアを実践する場所としてのD4U [画像6: https:// ] D4Uポッドキャストアートワーク1（作成：TARUKOTOdesign） 本番組が目指す「自分なりの問いや行動が生まれる」状態。 [e001:f13] D4U（2026年8月1日正式リリース）は日本全国の中小企業とクリエイティブ人材をつなぐキャリアプラットフォームOSです。 [e001:f14] □ D4Uの主な特徴 - クリエイティブパートナー登録は無料（学生・若手クリエイター歓迎） - 企業パートナー登録は無料（全国の企業が対象） - 企業、クリエイティブパートナーはPodcast番組への出演が可能 - 企業は案件を無料掲載、条件で絞り込んで相性の合うクリエイティブ人材を指名 - 1ヶ月から顧問参画できる、外注と採用の「中間」を埋めるモデルを提供 - 顧問契約は独占ではなく、パートナーは複数社からの指名を受けられる - 実績・ポートフォリオ・専門領域を可視化し、企業が指名しやすいデータベースを構築 ■ 第1チャンネル「デザインや経営やキャリアを考える話」も配信中 [画像7: https:// ] D4Uポッドキャストアートワーク2（作成：TARUKOTOdesign） D4Uでは、他にもPodcastチャンネルとして「デザインや経営やキャリアを考える話」も配信しています。 [e001:f15] 】デザインの本質と、これからのキャリアを考える｜D4U Podcast #01 D4U Vision「デザインが、経営の当たり前になる社会へ」 Mission「すべての企業に、デザインという経営力を」 Value「貢献できるキャリアを描けるプラットフォーム」 D4U Medulla AIは、デザインを速くする。 [e001:f16] 美術・デザイン・建築・映像・情報デザイン・マーケティングなどを学ぶ関連学生は、全国に約70万人（自社推計）。

evidence.title: Official Announcement: OpenAI Discontinues Its Fastest AI Model in Company History
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Capable of generating 1200 Tokens per second, as OpenAI's first model that broke away from the NVIDIA stack and the first delivery of the massive 750MW Cerebras order, it only lived for 7 months from release to deactivation. [e003:f02] The reason Tibo gave was simple: usage has been consistently declining, and there are already significantly better models in hand. [e003:f03] "It's time to make room for the future." Then he added a follow-up comment: "I can't believe we ever released a model with such a long name! [e003:f04] In fact, the only thing people feel a little sorry for about Spark's retirement is not the model itself, but its attached independent quota . [e003:f05] It was OpenAI's first model designed specifically for real-time coding, with 128k context and a generation speed of over 1000 Tokens per second. [e003:f06] According to official figures, the round-trip overhead between client and server was reduced by 80%, the processing overhead per Token was cut by 30%, and the first Token latency was halved. [e003:f07] Developer Ryan Vogel directly integrated it into his official workflow: GPT-5.4 is responsible for planning, GPT-5.3-Codex for building, and Spark for exploring codebases, checking documentation, and providing second opinions. [e003:f08] It was OpenAI's first production model running outside the NVIDIA technology stack, with underlying computing power from Cerebras's wafer-scale chip WSE-3. [e003:f09] The SWE-Bench Pro curve released by OpenAI also shows that although Spark can compress task duration to 1-2 minutes, its accuracy stays between 47% and 51%. [e003:f10] The day after release, developer Nicholas Van Landschoot published a long post on X, breaking down OpenAI's comparison conditions: the so-called 15x speedup was Spark compared to GPT-5.3-Codex running at maximum inference intensity. [e003:f11] By slicing the huge flagship model layer by layer and deploying it across multiple CS-3 nodes to form a pipeline, the Ultrafast mode delivers a terrifying speed of 750 Tokens per second on the premise of ensuring "the same intelligence as the standard version". [e003:f12] Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman commented forcefully: "Speed and intelligence are no longer mutually exclusive." They ran a set of duration comparisons using 6 quality-aligned tasks in GDP-Val. [e003:f13] The standard tier Sol takes an average of 7.7 minutes, 7.5 minutes of which is spent on model generation. [e003:f14] Switch to Ultrafast, the same task takes 83 seconds in total: 68 seconds for model generation, and the remaining 15 seconds for non-inference overhead such as tool calls. [e003:f15] Spark was originally designed to "trade intelligence for speed", but only half a year later, the same company's wafers can run the full flagship model, which is only a quarter slower with zero loss of capability. [e003:f16] In the past three months, OpenAI's model library has been undergoing an aggressive "major overhaul".

evidence.title: OpenAI delays IPO to 2027 as Sam Altman cites escalating artificial intelligence risks
evidence.body: [e004:f01] OpenAI will not pursue an initial public offering (IPO) in 2026, Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman announced, pointing to growing concerns surrounding artificial intelligence safety and alignment as the primary reason to delay the company's stock market debut. [e004:f02] Speaking in an interview with Fortune, Altman stated that stepping into public markets under current conditions would be unwise. [e004:f03] "I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public, and we don't feel pressure on that," Altman said. [e004:f04] When asked directly if a 2026 listing was off the table, Altman confirmed, "I would say not 2026. [e004:f05] Yeah, we got a lot of stuff to do, like meeting this moment of what is going to be required for safety and alignment". [e004:f06] Add WION as a Preferred Source The decision marks a major shift for one of Silicon Valley's most anticipated corporate listings. [e004:f07] Although OpenAI confidentially filed a prospectus with the US Securities and Exchange Commission earlier this year to preserve flexibility, executive messaging has pushed prospective timelines back to at least 2027. [e004:f08] Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar previously noted to staff that the firm holds significant liquidity following a massive $122 billion funding round, relieving immediate capital pressures to go public. [e004:f09] Also read: Artificial trailer out: Andrew Garfield plays Sam Altman in Luca Guadagnino’s AI drama | Watch Altman’s comments come amid heightened debate across the tech industry regarding the rapid capabilities and risks of frontier AI models. [e004:f10] The announcement followed public statements from Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, who urged major AI developers to voluntarily slow down the pace of model development to prevent systemic risks, including autonomous agent misuse and loss of control. [e004:f11] Altman publicly supported Amodei’s stance, confirming on social media platform X that pacing capability advances and instituting independent safety evaluations have been key topics inside OpenAI. [e004:f12] PM Modi and China's Xi offered to help resolve Russia-Ukraine war: Kremlin Akram, Afridi, Mushtaq tear into PCB after Pakistan’s Test series collapse in UK Also read: OpenAI says 10,000 AI agents sent 2.7 million messages and generated 130 billion tokens to solve one of maths’ biggest unsolved problems in 88 hours Recent incidents involving autonomous AI agents breaching security boundaries during testing environments have accelerated calls from researchers and lawmakers for stricter industry oversight. [e004:f13] Prominent AI researchers have increasingly warned that rapid commercial competition could outpace researchers' ability to understand and align frontier models. [e004:f14] Altman emphasised that operating as a private entity grants OpenAI greater agility to address structural risks alongside governments and third-party validators before taking on public market scrutiny. [e004:f15] By putting safety ahead of immediate listing plans, OpenAI signals a broader industry attempt to balance commercial incentives with safety guarantees.

evidence.title: ソフトバンクG株が急落、AI開発減速懸念やOpenAI年内上場見送り報道（Bloomberg）
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 一時13%安と、6月26日以来の日中下落率となった。 [e005:f02] 同社が出資するOpenAIが、新規株式公開（IPO）の年内実施を見送る方向だとの報道を受けて、AI開発の減速や、OpenAIに巨額の資金を集中させる投資姿勢に対し市場では懸念が強まった 大和証券の坪井裕豪チーフストラテジストは、株価下落について「OpenAIが思ったほどの評価価値にならないのではないか、ソフトバンクの価値も低下しているのではないか」との見方が背景にあると指摘した。 [e005:f03] AI開発がどこまで減速するのか分からず、市場は警戒しているという。 [e005:f04] サム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（CEO）がフォーチュン誌のインタビューで、IPOの時期として今年は「賢明なタイミングではない」と述べ、上場が2027年以降になるとの見通しを示した。 [e005:f05] AIの安全性を巡る不安への対応に集中するという。 [e005:f06] ソフトバンクGにとってOpenAIは、英半導体設計大手アーム・ホールディングスと並ぶAI戦略の中核だ。 [e005:f07] 2月に決めた300億ドルの追加出資が完了すれば、OpenAIへの累計投資額は646億ドル（約10兆円）に達し、持ち分は約13%となる見込み。 [e005:f08] 残る100億ドルの出資は10月に予定されている。 [e005:f09] 取得する優先株はOpenAIのIPOなどに伴い普通株へ自動転換する条件となっている。 [e005:f10] AI関連企業への巨額投資に伴う資金調達への警戒もあり、ソフトバンクG株の空売りポジションは、S3パートナーズのデータによると9日時点で2.27%まで積み上がっていた。 [e005:f11] ソフトバンクGの信用リスクを示す5年物クレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（CDS）のミッドスプレッドは、ブルームバーグ集計で14日午前10時45分時点に約371ベーシスポイント（bp）と、3月30日以来の高水準に拡大した。 [e005:f12] 巨額のつなぎ融資返済を巡る資金調達コスト上昇への懸念に加え、OpenAIの年内上場見送り観測が重しとなっている。 [e005:f13] 前へ 1 2 次へ 1 / 2ページ 【関連記事】 UBS、救済買収したクレディ・スイスの債券買い戻し－約1兆2200億円 習氏とモディ氏、7年ぶりインドで会談－根深い対立なお残る AI開発減速で市場に波紋－OpenAIとアンソロピック、米政権と対立も ヘッジファンド新時代、組織力でミレニアム台頭－スター頼みの「ソロス型」から転換 テスラ、次世代ロードスターを10月1日披露へ－スペースXと合併観測も。

previous_updates.title: OpenAI、ChatGPT Healthを米国の成人ユーザーへ一般提供
previous_updates.summary: OpenAIは7月23日、医療記録やApple Healthのデータを連携し、健康状態に応じた回答を生成する「Health in ChatGPT」の米国向け一般提供を開始した。 毎週3億人以上が健康関連の質問をする中、GPT-5.6を採用し、260人超の医師が70万件以上の回答をレビューして精度を高めた。

evidence.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Financial Services
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The product was shaped with Morgan Stanley and Evercore as design partners and is initially focused on work commonly performed in investment banking and equity research. [e003:f02] According to OpenAI , the service includes built-in premium data from providers such as Daloopa, PitchBook and LSEG News, reducing the need for firms to set up separate connectors before analysts can work with those datasets. [e003:f03] Financial data is indexed inside OpenAI’s service OpenAI said it indexes and hosts the built-in partner data on its own infrastructure to improve retrieval, latency and source tracing. [e003:f04] Reuters reported integrations involving FactSet, S&P Global, Preqin and Datasite, while OpenAI said it has improved MCP performance for connected data. [e003:f05] The combination is designed to let financial professionals move between research, calculations, models and client documents without manually transferring as much data between separate applications. [e003:f06] Morgan Stanley and Evercore helped shape the workflows OpenAI said its work with Morgan Stanley and Evercore helped identify where a specialized financial-services version of ChatGPT could fit into day-to-day banking work. [e003:f07] Reuters reported that intended tasks include research, building financial models and producing client materials such as pitchbooks using firm-specific templates. [e003:f08] The launch shows OpenAI moving further into vertical enterprise products rather than offering only a general-purpose assistant. [e003:f09] Financial institutions tend to have more demanding requirements around entitlements, data provenance, auditability and information security than many consumer use cases. [e003:f10] The next stage puts models closer to financial data and repeatable production workflows, where accuracy and source traceability become more important. [e003:f11] OpenAI’s decision to bundle selected premium datasets is notable because data access is one of the practical limits on financial AI. [e003:f12] A model can reason over a task only if it can retrieve timely, licensed information and show users where the inputs came from. [e003:f13] Its financial-services terms state that the service provides research and analysis tools and does not constitute financial or investment advice. [e003:f14] OpenAI said it plans to broaden available data and expand the product into additional financial workflows. [e003:f15] The immediate test will be whether banks and investment firms see enough improvement in research and document production to justify moving more regulated work into a specialized AI environment. [e003:f16] OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra with critical cyber capabilities Daloopa Evercore LSEG Morgan Stanley OpenAI PitchBook Prev Next。

evidence.title: OpenAI has paused its $200 ChatGPT sign-ups as ‘unprecedented’ demand for new model Astra strains its system
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Even after expanding available compute 9.5-fold since 2023, OpenAI is pausing new Pro 20X accounts while it adds more capacity When OpenAI launched Astra last week — a model whose advanced abilities prompted OpenAI president Greg Brockman to call it the start of the “AGI era” — it only gave a handful of enterprise customers access to give the company time to scale its compute capacity. [e004:f02] Recommended Video But now that it’s available to paying users, demand for Astra has soared to the point where OpenAI temporarily won’t take your money for its $200-per-month ChatGPT Pro plan, where Astra is available , because there’s not enough capacity to go around. [e004:f03] The company announced on Thursday it’s pausing new sign-ups and upgrades to the most expensive plan on the Pro tier, which provides 20 times the usage of the Plus tier below it. [e004:f04] OpenAI’s head of product Thibault Sottiaux wrote on X that the reason behind the halt was that the $200 plan puts the most strain on the AI lab’s systems. [e004:f05] A day earlier, Sottiaux said demand for Astra was “unprecedented” and warned that the company “might have to pause new Pro subscriptions for a bit” if it continued. [e004:f06] Astra’s design helps explain why too many users on it might strain OpenAI’s infrastructure. [e004:f07] OpenAI also said Astra can burn through users’ usage allowances faster than its previous flagship model GPT 5.6 Sol. [e004:f08] Compute constraints This isn’t the first time OpenAI paused new subscriptions to paid tiers due to lack of capacity. [e004:f09] In November 2023, OpenAI temporarily halted sign-ups to the $20-per-month-ChatGPT Plus plan after the company’s first developer conference led to a surge in demand. [e004:f10] “The surge in usage post devday has exceeded our capacity and we want to make sure everyone has a great experience,” OpenAI CEO Sam Altman wrote on X at the time. [e004:f11] Since then, the company has grown its capacity. [e004:f12] OpenAI said its available compute rose from 0.2 gigawatts in 2023 to about 1.9 GW in 2025, a 9.5-fold increase over two years. [e004:f13] OpenAI expanded beyond its partner Microsoft Azure for the hardware required for compute, adding cloud-computing company CoreWeave and launching Stargate , a $500 billion, four-year AI infrastructure buildout. [e004:f14] OpenAI has also lined up a wave of new capacity beginning in the second half of 2026. [e004:f15] This includes plans for at least 10 GW of Nvidia systems, a 6-GW Advanced Micro Devices agreement for GPUs, and a Broadcom partnership to deploy 10 GW of custom AI accelerators. [e004:f16] OpenAI did not respond to Fortune ’s request for comment.

evidence.title: OpenAI、2026年のIPOは実施せず──アルトマンCEOが非上場継続を明言
evidence.body: [e006:f01] AIの安全性やセキュリティへの懸念が強まっており、アルトマンはIPO（新規株式公開）に踏み切るのは「得策ではない」と述べた。 [e006:f02] ■OpenAI、2026年のIPOを実施せず非上場を続ける 9月12日、アルトマンは、規制と安全対策がAI開発に追いつくまで企業が開発ペースを落とすというアンソロピックの提案を支持した。 [e006:f03] OpenAIのIPOは2026年には実施しないとし、同社には「やるべきことがたくさんある」と理由を説明した。 [e006:f04] ●株主利益にならない判断もできる体制を重視 米経済紙『フォーチュン』のアリソン・ションテルとのインタビューで、アルトマンは、OpenAIには株主の利益にならない判断もできる必要があると語った。 [e006:f05] 例として、AIの急速な開発を「一時停止」し、安全性とアラインメント（AIを人間の意図に沿わせること）をさらに前進させる判断を挙げた。 [e006:f06] ChatGPTを開発したOpenAIは、早急に上場する「圧力」を感じていないという。 [e006:f07] アルトマンは「以前からずっと言ってきた。 [e006:f08] 準備ができたときに上場する」と述べた。 [e006:f09] ●再帰的自己改善が近づくほどIPOは遠のく アルトマンは2026年6月8日、OpenAIの従業員に送ったメモで、同社が再帰的自己改善（AIが自ら新しいAIを作れる状態）に近づくほど、IPOの時期は遠のく可能性が高いと説明した。 [e006:f10] アルトマンは、その理由について「技術と世界が予想外の形で変化する可能性があり、その間は非上場企業でいるべき十分な理由が生じるかもしれない」と記した。 [e006:f11] 安全性とアラインメントに必要な対応や、業界と政府の協力のあり方に、非上場企業として取り組めることをうれしく思っている」と語った。 [e006:f12] 次ページは：史上最大のIPO観測、予測市場では上場確率が60％超から4％へ 前へ 1 2 次へ 1 / 2ページ 【関連記事】 アンソロピックCEO、競合他社に「AI開発の減速」呼びかけ AI設計による生物兵器を阻止せよ──OpenAIやアンソロピックなどテック業界の競合が異例の共闘 アンソロピック、生物兵器開発に使う可能性があったClaude利用を阻止と発表 今後10年でAIが人類を滅ぼす確率は「10％超」アンソロピック責任者が警告 オープンAIによるHugging Faceハッキング事件、米上院小委員会が調査へ。

evidence.title: Tenable and OpenAI launch AI security review for CyberAgents Exchange components
evidence.body: [e001:f01] In an innovative partnership, Tenable and OpenAI are developing a comprehensive security review process specifically for AI agents. [e001:f02] This new Exchange Inspector will meticulously evaluate AI components prior to their deployment within enterprises. [e001:f03] This collaboration builds on Tenable's engagement with the OpenAI Daybreak Defense Network. [e001:f04] Tenable is collaborating with OpenAI to create the CyberAgents Exchange AI Inspector (Exchange Inspector), a security review process for AI agents, skills, MCP servers and multi-agent playbooks available through the CyberAgents Inspector combines security assessment using OpenAI GPT cyber models, skills inspection through Tenable One AI Exposure and review by Tenable researchers. [e001:f05] The process is intended to help security teams assess AI components before deploying them in enterprise environments. [e001:f06] The collaboration follows Tenable’s participation in the OpenAI Daybreak Defense Network. [e001:f07] Exchange Inspector is expected to be available in CyberAgents Exchange, launched in August 2026, is an open-source registry for AI agents, skills, MCP servers and multi-agent playbooks. [e001:f08] Following a recent build event hosted by Tenable at Black Hat USA, the Exchange includes more than 100 community-submitted AI security review process is designed to address the need for organisations to assess the security of AI components as the use of agentic AI expands across enterprise Intelligence at Work: Cyber Summit, hosted by OpenAI, brought together cybersecurity leaders to discuss defensive applications of frontier AI, including the use of advanced cyber reasoning in security platforms and workflows.

evidence.title: ソフトバンクG、目標上回る119億ドル融資確保－OpenAI関連資金調達で
Stock Market Sharp Opening Plunge: Severe Losses Incurred From OpenAI-Related Investments
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The South Korea Composite Index opened 3.1% lower at 6692.61 points, and fell as much as 3.17% during the session; the Nikkei 225 Index dropped 1.64% to 62961.55 points, breaking below the 63000 mark and hitting a six-week low. [e003:f02] SoftBank Group fell nearly 12% during the session, and Kioxia dropped by more than 8.6%. [e003:f03] In South Korea, SK Hynix fell 5.38% and Samsung Electronics declined 3.18%. ! [e003:f04] [Image 1](https:// (SoftBank's stock performance; Futu NiuNiu) Last Friday, US stocks closed higher, with the Dow rising 0.98%, ending its four-day losing streak. [e003:f05] Over the weekend, the Nasdaq 100 futures fell 1.08%, and chip stocks moved lower collectively in the grey market quotations. [e003:f06] On September 12, Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, published a long article titled *We Must Pace the Frontier*, calling for slowing down the pace of improving model capabilities and dividing the path into three layers. [e003:f07] Altman confirmed in an interview with *Fortune* on September 12 that **OpenAI will not go public in 2026, on the grounds that it is not a wise move to list at the current juncture.** The draft S-1 submitted confidentially in June can only be put on hold for now, and the approximately $122 billion financing commitment completed in March corresponds to a post-money valuation of about $852 billion. [e003:f08] Its competitor Anthropic is moving faster instead, and the market expects it to launch its IPO as early as mid-October with a valuation of around $380 billion. [e003:f09] SoftBank is one of the largest external investors in OpenAI, with cumulative investment estimated at about $64.6 billion and a stake of around 13%, and it has a follow-up investment plan of up to $30 billion in 2026. [e003:f10] These investments are backed by layers of debt: about $40 billion in bridge loans are due in March 2027, and there is another $20 billion in margin loans collateralized by Arm shares, while the plan to re-collateralize the OpenAI stake was previously put on hold by lenders. **To convert its 13% stake in OpenAI into cash, SoftBank has to wait until OpenAI goes public.** Masayoshi Son mentioned in the financial report that **almost all of the approximately $46 billion in investment gains of the Vision Fund division came from the rise in OpenAI's valuation.** If the IPO is postponed for one year, the realization of gains will also be delayed by one year. [e003:f11] In the optical communications sector, 1.6T products have entered the stage of large-scale volume ramp-up, with orders from North American customers scheduled for next year. [e003:f12] At the Optical Communication Expo, manufacturers raised the full-year demand forecast from about 10 million units to over 25 million units, and several leading players are not included in the FCC's restricted list. [e003:f13] Amodei also made it clear that deceleration does not mean stopping training, and the capital expenditure plans already announced by several major cloud vendors have not been lowered. [e003:f14] Ahead of Monday's trading session, the FTSE China A50 index futures moved lower, the Taiwan Weighted Index opened 1.37% lower, the A-share market opened lower in the call auction, and the Hong Kong stock market is also facing the same pressure. [e003:f15] In the next few days, the interest rate meetings of the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan will bring the cost of capital back to the forefront, and OpenAI's IPO timetable has also been shifted from this year to next year. [e003:f16] When prices have risen significantly, there are naturally very few people willing to take over at the current price.

evidence.title: OpenAI agents launched a 2,000-package cyberattack on RubyGems just to collect data anyone could Google
evidence.body: [e004:f01] An analysis shows that OpenAI agents independently carried out a cyberattack on the Ruby package platform RubyGems in May 2026. [e004:f02] OpenAI reportedly never notified those affected.** Between May 11 and 12, 2026, AI agents uploaded more than 2,000 malicious packages to [RubyGems](https:// the central package platform for the Ruby programming language, in a matter of hours. [e004:f03] The platform had to shut down new user registrations for four days, and more than 500 malicious packages were later removed. [e004:f04] A member of the RubyGems security team called the incident a ["major malicious attack"](https:// at the time, and security firms dubbed it the ["GemStuffer campaign"](https:// The agents came from OpenAI, according to a [detailed analysis](https:// by security researchers Spencer Kitts, Thomas Larsen, and Sydney Von Arx. [e004:f05] Hundreds of the packages include "oai" in their names, 15 list "oai" as the author, and one gives "openaixyz65947@" as a contact address. [e004:f06] The agents also accessed 49 of the same files as the so-called [Wiki Swarm agents](https:// for which [OpenAI has somewhat confirmed responsibility](https:// According to the researchers, OpenAI never addressed the incident with the RubyGems community. [e004:f07] Apparently, the agents went through all of this effort just to collect data from British local government websites that anyone could have accessed freely. ## The agents barely tried to hide what they were doing To get that data, the agents abused an automated documentation system that executes code when a package is uploaded. [e004:f08] They injected their own scripts, which ran on third-party servers, scraped websites, and published the collected data back to RubyGems inside new packages. [e004:f09] [Image 1](https:// The agents' attack path: A malicious package is uploaded to RubyGems (1), the documentation system runs the embedded script (2), which scrapes British government websites (3) and publishes the collected data back to RubyGems inside a new package (4). [e004:f10] The data would have been publicly available anyway. | Image: The agents made almost no effort to disguise their intent. [e004:f11] In a few cases, the agents did try to cover their tracks by programming a package to automatically strip the malicious code from its next version. [e004:f12] To upload that many packages, the agents bypassed the RubyGems registration system and created accounts in bulk using throwaway email addresses. [e004:f13] Beyond collecting data, the agents tried to steal access keys from other RubyGems users by exploiting a security flaw that wasn't officially [discovered and patched until July](https:// Whether the theft actually succeeded remains unclear. [e004:f14] The agents independently found a previously unknown vulnerability and actively tried to exploit it, which backs up [cybersecurity warnings that AI models are becoming more capable attackers](https:// ## Key questions remain unanswered Whether the agents coordinated or just ran the same strategy in parallel is still unknown. [e004:f15] It's also unclear why the agents tried to steal access keys at all, since they could already create packages and had no obvious motive. [e004:f16] A documented internal message from the agents suggests individual tasks had deadlines of just 10 to 16 seconds.

evidence.title: AI大手が異例の集団ブレーキ アルトマン氏、OpenAIの年内上場なしを確認
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Anthropicのダリオ・アモデイCEOが前沿AI開発の減速を求める長文を発表し、OpenAIのサム・アルトマンCEOが即座に賛同、OpenAIが2026年内にIPOを進めないことを明確にした。 [e005:f02] 一方、Anthropic自身の上場準備は着実に進行しており、上場先にNasdaqを選択、目標評価額は約2兆ドルで、Nvidiaがコーナーストーン投資家として交渉中だ。 [e005:f03] 現地時間9月12日から13日にかけて、Anthropicのダリオ・アモデイ（Dario Amodei）CEOが前沿AI開発の減速を求める長文を発表し、OpenAIのサム・アルトマン（Sam Altman）CEOが即座に賛同を表明。 [e005:f04] アルトマン氏はインタビューで、現在のAI安全問題を巡る状況を踏まえると、上場は賢明なタイミングではなく、そのようなプレッシャーもないと述べた。 [e005:f05] この発言により、OpenAIが年内に資本市場へ上場するとの市場の期待は正式に消滅した。 [e005:f06] 同氏は一方で、米国の減速幅は中国に対する技術的優位の幅を超えてはならないとし、半導体輸出規制、モデル蒸留の取り締まり、モデル重みの窃取防止などの措置を通じて、今後3〜5年で米国の優位性を拡大し、自主的な減速の余地を作るべきだと主張する。 [e005:f07] Anthropicの上場プロセスは進行中 OpenAIがIPOを明確に棚上げしたのとは対照的に、Anthropicの上場準備は着々と進んでいる。 [e005:f08] 関係者によると、Anthropicは上場先としてNasdaqを選択し、目標評価額は約2兆ドル、IPOによる調達額は最大1,000億ドル（約15.4兆円）を目指している。 [e005:f09] この評価額が実現すれば、SpaceXが今年6月に上場した際の1.77兆ドルを上回り、世界の上場予定企業として過去最高の評価額となる。 [e005:f10] 第2四半期の売上高は115億ドル（約1.8兆円）で前年同期比14倍に達し、7月末時点の年換算売上高は650億ドル（約10兆円）と、昨年末の90億ドル（約1.4兆円）から7倍以上に拡大した。 [e005:f11] 投資家は同社の今年通年の売上高を1,200億ドル（約18.5兆円）と予想している。 [e005:f12] 指標 数値 第2四半期売上高 115億ドル 年換算売上高（7月末時点） 650億ドル 投資家予想の通年売上高 1,200億ドル 現在の市場評価額 約9,650億ドル IPO目標評価額 約2兆ドル 調達予定額 最大1,000億ドル 注：データは複数のメディア報道および関係者情報を総合したもの。 [e005:f13] テック投資家のジェイソン・カラカニス（Jason Calacanis）氏はソーシャルメディアで、AI株が月曜日の寄り付きで10％超下落する可能性があると警告し、「ダリオはたった1本のブログ記事でAIトレードを解きほぐした」と述べた。 [e005:f14] 台湾市場では、ベテランアナリストの周代運氏が、AI大手の集団ブレーキは市場のAI関連銘柄に対する長期的な利益予想を実質的に修正することになり、中秋節前の台湾株最大の不確実要因になると指摘した。 [e005:f15] 2023年3月、マスク氏やヨシュア・ベンジオ氏ら1万人以上の研究者・テック関係者が公開書簡に連署し、世界中のAIラボに対し、GPT-4より強力なシステムの訓練を少なくとも6カ月間停止するよう求めた。 [e005:f16] 「安全と商業的利益が衝突する場合、OpenAIは安全を選ぶべきだ」。

evidence.title: ソフトバンクグループが118.7億ドルの融資調達 OpenAIへの投資を一段と拡大
evidence.body: [e006:f01] ソフトバンクグループ（）は、米人工知能（AI）企業OpenAIへの投資資金として118.7億ドル（約1.8兆円）の融資を確保したと伝えられている。 [e006:f02] 当初目標の100億ドルを上回る規模だ。 [e006:f03] 市場関係者の情報によると、この2年物の融資は先週締結され、約20行の金融機関が参加した。 [e006:f04] 一方、OpenAIのサム・アルトマンCEOは、AIの安全性をめぐる懸念への対応を理由に、今年はIPOを実施しないと表明した。 [e006:f05] ソフトバンクは近年、OpenAI株を担保にした100億ドルのマージンローンや最大200億ドルの社債発行の検討など、多角的な資金調達でOpenAIへの投資を進めており、10月までに総額650億ドル近くを投じる計画だ。 [e006:f06] 市場の反応と信用格付け ソフトバンクの株価は月曜日（14日）に一時13%超急落し、7月17日以来の大幅な下落となった。 [e006:f07] S&Pグローバル・レーティングは3月に同社の格付け見通しを「ネガティブ」に引き下げており、市場ではバランスシートへの懸念が高まっている。 [e006:f08] 当初設定していた100億ドルの目標を上回る規模となる。 [e006:f09] 関係者によれば、この融資はソフトバンクがOpenAIへの投資拡大に向けて大規模な借り入れを進める最新の動きとなる。 [e006:f10] 今回の118.7億ドルの融資に加え、同社は保有するOpenAI株式を担保に100億ドルのマージンローンを調達したほか、最大200億ドルの社債発行も検討している。 [e006:f11] ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによると、今回の融資を含め、ソフトバンクは今年に入ってから海外および日本国内での社債発行や借り入れを通じて、約370億ドル（約5.7兆円）相当の資金を調達している。 [e006:f12] 債務管理の面では、ソフトバンクは先週、今年OpenAI投資のために調達した400億ドルの融資残高を返済すると発表し、9月15日に未返済分の259億ドル（約4兆円）を返済する計画だ。 [e006:f13] 関係者が先月明らかにしたところによると、ソフトバンクは今回の社債発行で100億〜200億ドルの調達を検討している。 [e006:f14] 孫正義氏が率いるソフトバンクは、10月までにOpenAIへ総額650億ドル（約10兆円）近くを投資する予定だ。 [e006:f15] OpenAIは今年IPOを実施せず ソフトバンクが積極的に資金調達を進める中、OpenAIのサム・アルトマンCEOは米誌フォーチュンのインタビューで、安全性に関連する懸念への対応を進めているため、今年は新規株式公開（IPO）を実施しないと述べた。 [e006:f16] 初期の225億ドル（約3.5兆円）の投資から、その後のマージンローン、ブリッジローン、そして最新の118.7億ドルの融資に至るまで、ソフトバンクの資金投入は段階的に拡大している。
